name: Pre-K (4 to 5 years)
notes: Full-time. Meals and snacks are included in tuition.

name: Registration fee
notes: Non-refundable, due when a place is accepted.

name: Annual supply fee
notes: Covers art supplies, cot sheets and classroom materials. Charged each September.

name: Late pickup fee
notes: Starts at 6:01 PM. Billed on the next monthly invoice.

name: Returned payment fee
notes: Charged for a returned check or declined automatic payment.

name: Sibling discount
notes: 10% off the tuition of the older child when two or more siblings are enrolled.

name: Tuition due date
notes: Due on the 1st of the month; considered late after the 5th.
